title: 第5章 那就叫知白吧参知白第6章 王府闹鬼
slug: 别人修仙我闲逛游历三界终长生
content_zh:
纪风一手抓住人参精的手腕，一手掐动障眼法。
庙外，山顶上。
一高一低两道人影，远远望着那团火光。
庙烧起来了。
火越烧越旺，浓烟滚滚，火舌舔着天边，把半边山都映红了。
远远的，能看到刘员外和那些家仆们站在庙外，四个镖师站在庙宇的四个方向，手拿大刀，时刻防着从红光中窜出的身影。
但显然他们失算了。
人参精望着它的庙，被火光一点一点吞噬，倒塌，半天没说话。
纪风站在旁边，看着那火。
忽然，人参精开口道：
“公子，为什么？”
纪风没回答。
“我救了他。”人参精的声音发颤：
“那年他摔下悬崖，整个人浑身是血，是我救的他，用了我大半的须子，差点回到土里。”
“他没钱娶媳妇，是我给他的须子，卖了换钱，才娶的媳妇。”
人参精好似在说给纪风听，又好似在自言自语。
“他娶媳妇，生儿子，发财，活到一百二十岁，都是我。”
“我每年都给他须子，好多年都没有断过。他每次来，我都看着他，听他讲外面的一切。”
“可他为什么要烧我庙，为什么要吃我？”
“哎。”

纪风叹息一声，缓缓道：
“世人贪婪，得了千钱想万钱，长命百岁，又想长生不老，人呐......”
人参精低下头，从身后揪了根须子，瞅了半天：
“我都未曾长生，何来吃了我，就能长生。”
纪风没说话。
火还在烧，烧了很久。
刘员外等人也等了很久，直到山灵大王庙只剩几根黑漆漆的石柱在那立着。
“没有？”
“我真的？不能长生？”
忽然，刘员外的身躯向后倒去，狠狠的砸在地面上。
“老爷！”
“老爷！”
李管家和家仆们纷纷扑了过去，查看情况。
“快，扶老爷上马车，下山！下山！！！”
不一会儿，庙前只剩马车车轮激起的烟尘滚滚。
纪风转身，往山下走去。
人参精扭过头，问道：
“公子，去哪儿？”
“不知道，闲逛。”
“闲逛是什么？”

“就是到处走走，到处看看。”
content_en:
Ji Feng grabbed Ginseng Jing's wrist with one hand and used the blinding technique with the other.
Outside the temple, on the top of the mountain.
Two figures, one high and one low, looked at the fire from a distance.
The temple was burned.
The fire burned more and more fiercely, thick smoke billowed, and the flames licked the sky, turning half of the mountain red.
From a distance, one could see Liu Yuanwai and the servants standing outside the temple. Four bodyguards stood in the four directions of the temple, holding broadswords in their hands, always on guard against the figures emerging from the red light.
But apparently they miscalculated.
The ginseng spirit looked at its temple, which was swallowed up bit by bit by the fire, collapsed, and said nothing for a long time.
Ji Feng stood aside and looked at the fire.
Suddenly, Ginseng Essence said:
"Sir, why?"
Ji Feng didn't answer.
"I saved him." Ginseng Jing's voice trembled:
"That year he fell off a cliff and was covered in blood. I saved him, using most of my beard, and he almost fell back into the earth."
"He didn't have money to get a wife. I gave him a beard and sold it for money, so he got a wife."
Ginseng essence seems to be talking to Ji Feng, but also seems to be talking to itself.
"He gets a wife, gives birth to a son, makes a fortune, and lives to be one hundred and twenty years old. It's all me."
"I give him a beard every year, and it has not been broken for many years. Every time he comes, I look at him and listen to him talk about everything outside."
"But why did he burn my temple and why did he eat me?"
"Hey."
Ji Feng sighed and said slowly:
"People in the world are greedy. They want thousands of dollars after they get a thousand dollars. They want to live a hundred years. They also want to be immortal. People..."
The ginseng spirit lowered his head, pulled out a root from behind, and looked at it for a long time:
"I have never lived forever, how can you live forever if you eat me?"
Ji Feng said nothing.
The fire was still burning, and it had been burning for a long time.
Liu Yuanwai and others also waited for a long time, until only a few dark stone pillars were left standing in Shanling Dawang Temple.
"No?"
"Am I really? Can't live forever?"
Suddenly, Liu Yuanwai's body fell backwards and hit the ground hard.
"Master!"
"Master!"
Butler Li and the servants rushed over to check the situation.
"Quickly, help me get on the carriage and get down the mountain! Down the mountain!!!"
After a while, only the smoke and dust stirred up by the carriage wheels were left in front of the temple.
Ji Feng turned around and walked down the mountain.
Ginseng Essence turned his head and asked:
"Master, where are you going?"
"I don't know, just hanging out."
"What's hanging out?"
"Just walking around and looking around."
